name: Franklin's Activity Center
summary:
Franklin’s Activity Center is a computer game that includes eleven different mini-games featuring Franklin the Turtle, based on the books from Kids Can Press by Paulette Bourgeois and Brenda Clark.

The player first starts in Franklin’s Room, where he or she can select a game to play with. The games range from jigsaw puzzles to matching games, and colouring pages to making greeting cards, as well as from dinosaur bone hunting to dressing up.

The level of difficulty can be changed to suit children ages four to nine.
